scope: Review of the three failed native-JWT fixture preconditions; no product changes and no new test results claimed.

observations.finding: Existing MountTokenType::parse accepts kebab-case default-batch and rejects default_batch. The fixed test retains unsupported-native-mode 501 checks, adds the invalid-spelling 400 check, and asserts no candidate delta or pending delivery.

Existing jwt_role_route requires update plus sudo and validate_assignment for the retained token policies. The fixed positive actor explicitly carries the assigned native-jwt policy; separate missing-assignment and missing-sudo negatives remain.

Existing validate_public_origin requires TokenApi provenance; exact path equality is mandatory for a named token role. The fixed unroled test distinguishes a valid public display path with a real issuer from a missing issuer, while retaining malformed-path and parent-graph negatives.
